body: Measured again with twenty people (docs/evidence/README.md#e02, `audit_people.py fair`): one person asks for 260 songs, another then asks for 20; the 20 run at positions 62 to 100 of 280 (they wait until the first backlog is under the 200-item window). The bar for done: the first of the 20 within the first 5, all 20 within the first 60 (taking turns would be about every second position). The script prints PASS/FAIL for exactly that.
